sql: WITH lp AS (SELECT DISTINCT pe.ZnodeProductId AS id, pe.Name AS nm, pe.SKU AS sk, p.PortalId AS po FROM dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = c.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = c.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = pc.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h ON h.PimCategoryHierarchyId = c.ZnodeCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct cp ON cp.PimCategoryId = h.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe ON pe.ZnodeProductId = cp.PimProductId AND pe.VersionId = c.VersionId WHERE v.RevisionType = @revisionType AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND p.StoreCode = @store AND c.ZnodeCategoryId = @categoryId AND cp.Status = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, c.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, pe.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero), pr AS (SELECT z.SKU AS sk, o.PortalId AS po, z.RetailPrice AS rp, o.Precedence AS o1, l.PriceListId AS o2, z.PriceId AS o3 FROM dbo.ZnodePrice z INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList l ON l.PriceListId = z.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal o ON o.PriceListId = l.PriceListId WHERE (l.ActivationDate IS NULL OR l.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (l.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR l.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (z.ActivationDate IS NULL OR z.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (z.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR z.ExpirationDate >= @now)), src AS (SELECT lp.id AS id, lp.id AS sid FROM lp UNION SELECT lp.id, k.PimProductId FROM lp INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation ta ON ta.PimParentProductId = lp.id INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct k ON k.PimProductId = ta.PimProductId WHERE k.IsActive = @isActive AND (SELECT TOP 1 x.rp FROM pr x WHERE x.sk = k.SKU AND x.po = lp.po ORDER BY x.o1, x.o2, x.o3) > @zero AND (SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse w ON w.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = k.SKU AND w.PortalId = lp.po) > @zero), pv AS (SELECT s.id AS id, a.AttributeCode AS ac, pdv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AS vi FROM src s INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av ON av.PimProductId = s.sid INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute a ON a.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimFrontendProperties fp ON fp.PimAttributeId = a.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue pdv ON pdv.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId WHERE fp.IsFacets = @isActive AND pdv.LocaleId = @localeId AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, a.AttributeCode, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, @attributeCodes, @comma)) > @zero), fv AS (SELECT pv.ac AS ac, MIN(CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, pv.ac, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, @attributeCodes, @comma))) AS lo, MAX(al.AttributeName) AS al, pv.vi AS vi, MAX(dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode) AS vc, MAX(dvl.AttributeDefaultValue) AS vl, MAX(dv.DisplayOrder) AS vo, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) AS pc FROM pv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue dv ON dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = pv.vi INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dvl ON dvl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeLocale al ON al.PimAttributeId = dv.PimAttributeId WHERE dvl.LocaleId = @localeId AND al.LocaleId = @localeId GROUP BY pv.ac, pv.vi), q AS (SELECT fv.ac, fv.al, fv.vi, fv.vc, fv.vl, fv.pc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fv.lo) AS ar, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fv.ac ORDER BY fv.pc DESC, fv.vo, fv.vi) AS vr, COUNT(fv.vi) OVER (PARTITION BY fv.ac) AS va FROM fv), r AS (SELECT q.ac, q.al, q.vi, q.vc, q.vl, q.pc, q.ar, q.va, CONCAT(q.ar, q.vr) AS sl FROM q), fr AS (SELECT lp.id, lp.nm, lp.sk, gp.rp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lp.id) AS n FROM lp INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pv.id FROM pv INNER JOIN r ON r.ac = pv.ac AND r.vi = pv.vi WHERE r.sl = @s11) fp1 ON fp1.id = lp.id OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x.rp FROM pr x WHERE x.sk = lp.sk AND x.po = lp.po ORDER BY x.o1, x.o2, x.o3) gp) SELECT TOP 1 MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos1 THEN r.ac END) AS facet1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos1 THEN r.al END) AS facet1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.vc END) AS facet1Value1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.vl END) AS facet1Value1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) AS facet1Value1Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s12 THEN r.vc END) AS facet1Value2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s12 THEN r.vl END) AS facet1Value2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s12 THEN r.pc END) AS facet1Value2Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s13 THEN r.vc END) AS facet1Value3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s13 THEN r.vl END) AS facet1Value3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s13 THEN r.pc END) AS facet1Value3Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos2 THEN r.ac END) AS facet2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos2 THEN r.al END) AS facet2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s21 THEN r.vc END) AS facet2Value1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s21 THEN r.vl END) AS facet2Value1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s21 THEN r.pc END) AS facet2Value1Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s22 THEN r.vc END) AS facet2Value2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s22 THEN r.vl END) AS facet2Value2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s22 THEN r.pc END) AS facet2Value2Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s23 THEN r.vc END) AS facet2Value3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s23 THEN r.vl END) AS facet2Value3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s23 THEN r.pc END) AS facet2Value3Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos3 THEN r.ac END) AS facet3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos3 THEN r.al END) AS facet3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s31 THEN r.vc END) AS facet3Value1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s31 THEN r.vl END) AS facet3Value1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s31 THEN r.pc END) AS facet3Value1Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s32 THEN r.vc END) AS facet3Value2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s32 THEN r.vl END) AS facet3Value2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s32 THEN r.pc END) AS facet3Value2Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s33 THEN r.vc END) AS facet3Value3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s33 THEN r.vl END) AS facet3Value3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s33 THEN r.pc END) AS facet3Value3Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) AS filteredCount, MAX(f.n1) AS filteredProduct1Name, MAX(f.s1) AS filteredProduct1Sku, MAX(f.i1) AS filteredProduct1ProductId, MAX(f.p1) AS filteredProduct1RetailPrice, MAX(f.n2) AS filteredProduct2Name, MAX(f.s2) AS filteredProduct2Sku, MAX(f.i2) AS filteredProduct2ProductId, MAX(f.p2) AS filteredProduct2RetailPrice, MAX(f.n3) AS filteredProduct3Name, MAX(f.s3) AS filteredProduct3Sku, MAX(f.i3) AS filteredProduct3ProductId, MAX(f.p3) AS filteredProduct3RetailPrice FROM r CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos1 THEN fr.nm END) AS n1, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos1 THEN fr.sk END) AS s1, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos1 THEN fr.id END) AS i1, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos1 THEN fr.rp END) AS p1, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos2 THEN fr.nm END) AS n2, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos2 THEN fr.sk END) AS s2, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos2 THEN fr.id END) AS i2, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos2 THEN fr.rp END) AS p2, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos3 THEN fr.nm END) AS n3, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos3 THEN fr.sk END) AS s3, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos3 THEN fr.id END) AS i3, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.n = @pos3 THEN fr.rp END) AS p3 FROM fr) f HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.ac) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttribute x WHERE CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, x.AttributeCode, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, @attributeCodes, @comma)) > @zero) AND MIN(r.va) >= @minValuesPerAttribute AND MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) >= @minProductsForValue AND MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) <= @maxProductsForValue ORDER BY facet1Code
